data.name: Project Polygon
data.detailed_description:
🔷 Welcome to Project Polygon

Project Polygon is a chaotic multiplayer platform shooter where no one gets eliminated.

No early knockouts.
No waiting on the sidelines.
No “game over” from a single mistake.

Every round is a new chance to come back.

🎯 No Elimination. Only Comebacks.

In most battle royale games, one mistake ends your run.

Not here.

In Project Polygon:

Everyone plays until the end
Every finish earns you points
Bad round? Come back stronger
Doing well? Hold your position

Everyone earns XP.
Only the best unlock special rewards.

Skill always matters.

⚡ Fast, Fun, and Absurd Chaos

Jump. Slide. Shoot. Fall. Recover. Win.

Fast-paced platform races
Fun physics and chaotic moments
Competitive, yet always enjoyable
Easy to learn, hard to master

Every match tells a new story.

🌐 Diverse Maps and Themes

One round you’re a pirate.
Next, you’re a farmer.
Suddenly, you’re in Japan.

From Caribbean islands to futuristic arenas,
every match feels different.

Expect surprises.

🎮 Core Features

🔫 Platform shooter gameplay
🌍 Online multiplayer
🏆 Point-based ranking system
♻️ No-elimination system
📊 Comeback mechanics
🎁 Special rewards for top players
⚡ Short and fast-paced matches
🤪 Absurd and fun atmosphere

🚀 Early Access & Community Rewards

Project Polygon is actively in development.

During Early Access, players who provide valuable feedback will:

Be featured in-game by name
Receive exclusive in-game rewards
Unlock surprise perks

Your feedback shapes the future of the game.

💙 Join the Journey

Project Polygon is passionately developed by two independent creators who believe multiplayer games should be fun, fair, and full of second chances.

Add it to your wishlist and follow the journey.

Every wishlist supports an indie dream.

Come on—
Let’s grow this chaos together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
